div.div: 1 خَدُلَ , inf. n. خَدَالَةٌ [and app. خُدُولَة also], He was, or became, large, and full [or plump], in the shank and fore arm. (TA.) [And in like manner, خَدُلَتْ; or خَدِلَتْ, inf. n. خَدَلٌ [q. v.]; She (a woman) was, or became, full, or plump, in the shanks and fore arms.] And خَدُلَتْ, inf. n. خَدَالَةٌ [and خُدُولَةٌ]; (JK;) or خَدِلَتْ, [inf. n. خَدَلٌ;] (K;) said of the shank (السَّاق, JK, K), It was, or became, round: (JK:) or full [or plump]. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
